# Market and competition

> Market sizing, differentiation, competition, platforms and two-sided markets, and the economics of personalisation, and a program that sizes a market bottom-up as an interval. First review written: market structure, ending on the baseline B1.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Market and competition](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/README.md): the scope, what the first review found, the baseline B1 and the questions it answered
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/evidence/README.md): the first review, on market structure, with the bibliography
- [Market structure](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/evidence/market-structure/README.md): 40 sources in five steps, with the claims table and the named baseline
- [Baseline](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/evidence/market-structure/baseline.md): B1, a market sized by two methods with intervals and a competition frame
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/evidence/bibliography.md): every work cited, once
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
